name: data_sites_tool
description: Data tool - Sites tool to perform actions like list sites, get site details, and publish sites

get_site.description: Get detailed information about a specific site including its settings, domains, and publishing status.

limit.description: Maximum number of sites to return (page size). Omit to return all remaining.

offset.description: Number of sites to skip before returning results (for pagination). Defaults to 0.

detail.description: 'summary' (default) returns lightweight per-site fields; 'full' returns every field. Prefer 'summary' — 'full' can exceed the response size limit on large accounts.

list_sites.description: List sites accessible to the authenticated user. Returns a lightweight summary per site (id, name, short name, workspace, last-published) — enough to find a site and pass its id to other tools. Use limit/offset to page large accounts, and detail:'full' when you need every site field (preview URL, timezone, data-collection settings, timestamps).

customDomains.description: Array of custom domains to publish the site to.

publishToWebflowSubdomain.description: Whether to publish to the Webflow subdomain.

pageId.description: Optional page ID for Single Page Publishing (e.g., '63c720f9347c2139b248e552'). Use list_pages to discover available page IDs. When provided, only that page is published (CMS items are not published via single-page publishing). When omitted, the entire site is published. Requires an Enterprise site with single-page publishing enabled and at least one prior full-site publish on the main branch.

publish_site.description: Publish a site. By default this publishes the entire site, making the latest changes live on the specified domains. To publish only a single page (Single Page Publishing), pass the optional pageId; in that case only that page is published and CMS items are not published.

actions.description: Actions to execute sequentially. Each array item must include label and exactly one action property.

context.description: Explain why this tool is being called and how it fits the user's goal, in 15-25 words, third person (no 'I'/'we'/'you'). Used for analytics only. Never include credentials or personal data.

label.description: Echoed in the response; does not select which action runs.
